content.title: Afya: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: NOVA LIMA, Brazil (AP) — Afya Ltd. (AFYA) on Wednesday reported third-quarter net income of $28.5 million. On a per-share basis, the Nova Lima, Brazil-based company said it had profit of 31 cents. Earnings, adjusted for amortization costs and non-recurring costs, came to 38 cents per share.
